notes:
# Waymark 0.5.5

- Added a clear startup notice explaining that Waymark must be open when you enter the world with your character. If already playing, return safely to AION 2 Character Selection, choose the character and enter again while Waymark stays open.
- The notice explains why a fresh world entry is needed and distinguishes the game login from selecting a saved profile inside Waymark.
- The reminder appears after startup checks when no character is connected, stays dismissed for that launch, and closes if the reader detects a character. It does not reopen after a later disconnection in the same launch.
- Added a remembered Don't show this at startup option, with a switch to restore it in Settings > Connection. First-run setup and waiting-for-character screens include the same instructions without stacking startup dialogs.
